readme.excerpt: A DSH plugin that exposes DeepSeek Harness over HTTP: the workspaces, sessions, models, settings, skills and files already inside DSH become plain REST endpoints and SSE streams, plus an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions so an existing OpenAI client can talk to DSH unchanged.
